skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-google-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Set up customer lifetime value bidding in Google Ads for a Lightspeed eCom store through Product Metrics. Verify revenue or profit conversion signals from eligible paid orders before changing campaign goals.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Google Ads lifetime value bidding for Lightspeed eCom.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown formatting, product documentation, or scoped integration checks. Confirmed risks include running an unpinned installer, using an authenticated remote tool, and retrieving order details. No evidence of malicious reconnaissance or prompt injection was found; credential handling and approval for setup changes need stronger safeguards.

remediation.issue: The optional installer invokes an unpinned npm package and does not pin the skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the reviewed installer version and skill revision. Require explicit approval before running the installer.

remediation.issue: The credential exception can put the Lightspeed API key and secret in chat or command inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the exception and direct users to enter credentials only in the verified Product Metrics app. Redact credentials from tool inputs, outputs, and logs.

remediation.issue: Setup writes and their retries lack an explicit approval step for the selected account and changes.
remediation.suggestion: Show the selected store, workspace, Google Ads account, and proposed changes. Require approval before writes and keep primary goals and campaign changes user-controlled.

remediation.issue: Order checks can retrieve more data than the request needs.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the storefront, use a test order when possible, and return only receipt status and the requested metrics. Suppress raw customer and order details.

remediation.issue: The tracking gateway uses Cloudflare offline access and Workers write permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Explain how to verify the Cloudflare account and zone, inspect deployed Workers and routes, and revoke access after disconnecting.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Handling Bypasses Browser-Only Entry
semantic_findings.description: The main skill allows taking the Lightspeed API key and secret from the user and passing them directly to a command. The connection guide instead says to enter them in the app and keep them out of chat. Direct handling can expose credentials through chat, tool records, or process arguments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both instructions are explicit and conflict. No protected input channel or guarantee of argument redaction is documented.

semantic_findings.title: Setup Writes Lack an Explicit Approval Step
semantic_findings.description: The workflow follows discovered identifiers into setup and provides retry rules without requiring approval of the target account and proposed writes. Secondary conversion actions still change account state and can enable onward data reporting. The user retains control of the primary goal.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The rules explicitly reserve primary goal changes for the user, but give no equivalent approval step for secondary setup writes or their retries.

semantic_findings.title: Cloudflare Gateway Grant Has Persistent Write Access
semantic_findings.description: The gateway setup requests offline access and permission to write Workers scripts and routes. The removal instructions describe gateway removal but do not explain how to verify the OAuth grant was revoked.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide names the offline and write permissions explicitly. It does not establish whether removing the gateway also revokes the grant.

content.user_title: Set Up Lightspeed LTV Bidding in Google Ads
content.value_statement: Bidding on individual purchases can miss the value of customers who buy again. Use Product Metrics to verify Lightspeed revenue or profit signals before switching a Google Ads campaign to lifetime value bidding.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status for the selected store and Google Ads account, or guide the user through the app.
Guide the user through storefront tracking, Google Ads Data Manager access, Merchant Center, and consent configuration.
Help create and verify the secondary Revenue LTV and Profit LTV conversion actions.
Check whether a paid test order arrived, whether the customer was recognized, and whether profit was available.
Guide the user through choosing one primary conversion action and a target return on ad spend, then verify the conversion action status.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series, Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and a Google Ads client account linked to Merchant Center.
Lifetime value reflects observed paid orders after connection. It is not a forecast and does not combine orders across stores.
Eligible conversions require customer recognition, analytics and ad user data consent, and matchable customer information. Profit LTV also requires known costs.
The user completes admin approvals and makes primary conversion and bidding changes in Google Ads.

use_cases.title: Check setup readiness
use_cases.description: Find missing store, tracking, or account connections before setting up lifetime value bidding.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing profit conversions
use_cases.description: Check whether a paid test order arrived and whether missing costs prevented a Profit LTV conversion.

use_cases.title: Pilot a lifetime value goal
use_cases.description: Plan one campaign switch after verifying secondary conversions, then confirm the selected goal after the user makes the change.

prompt_templates.title: List the prerequisites
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review the setup before connecting accounts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what my Lightspeed eCom store needs for Google Ads lifetime value bidding. Identify the steps I must complete in the browser.

prompt_templates.title: Check setup status
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Identify what is blocking setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Product Metrics setup for [store] and [Google Ads client account]. Confirm the accounts with me, then report completed and missing steps without making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a paid test order
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Diagnose a missing revenue or profit signal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether Product Metrics received paid test order [order ID] for [store]. Report customer recognition and revenue or profit availability without showing personal information.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-campaign pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Prepare a controlled switch to lifetime value bidding.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Revenue LTV and Profit LTV for [campaign]. Recommend one action, explain how to choose a target return, and give me the Google Ads steps. Do not change the campaign.

output_examples.input: What blocks lifetime value bidding for my store?
output: The Lightspeed store is connected and its configuration is current.
Google Ads is connected, but Data Manager access is missing.
Approve Data Manager access in Google, then verify both lifetime value actions are secondary.

output_examples.input: Did my paid test order produce a profit signal?
output: Product Metrics received the paid order and recognized a returning customer.
Revenue was available, but profit was not. The order has a missing cost.
Review the order costs before choosing Profit LTV as your primary conversion.

output_examples.input: How should I pilot Revenue LTV without counting purchases twice?
output: Verify that the secondary Revenue LTV action records eligible orders before changing the campaign.
Use Revenue LTV as the only primary purchase goal for the pilot campaign.
Choose a target based on the new conversion values. Do not copy the old purchase target automatically.

best_practices: Verify the store, workspace, and Google Ads client account before making changes. Enter credentials only in the verified app.
Verify consent settings and check a paid test order while both lifetime value actions are still secondary.
Start with one campaign and one primary purchase action. Verify the selected goal after the user changes it.
anti_patterns: Share API keys, secrets, or raw customer details in chat.
Make both Revenue LTV and Profit LTV primary for the same campaign.
Copy the old purchase target without checking how lifetime value is measured.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores does this support?
faq.answer: It supports Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: What Google Ads connections do I need?
faq.answer: Use the client account that runs your campaigns. Link Merchant Center and grant the requested Google Ads Data Manager access.

faq.question: What consent is needed for lifetime value conversions?
faq.answer: The visitor must allow analytics and ad user data. The order must also contain matchable information, such as an email address, phone number, or full address.

faq.question: Does the setup import past orders or predict future value?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics counts observed paid orders after the store connects. Each eligible conversion reports what that order adds to lifetime value.

faq.question: Why is Revenue LTV available but Profit LTV missing?
faq.answer: Revenue LTV does not require cost data. Profit LTV needs known order costs, including any applicable additional costs such as payment fees.

faq.question: Who makes the lifetime value conversion primary?
faq.answer: You make the change in Google Ads. The assistant can verify which conversion action is primary afterward.
